literature.headline_zh: 禽流感病毒跨物种传播与适应性进化研究进展。
literature.lead_zh: 本周研究揭示了H5N1病毒在北美家禽和奶牛中的广泛传播与适应性突变,H5N5在北极野生动物中的出现,以及新型H3N8/H3N3病毒在中国的潜在风险,同时展示了新型疫苗和抗病毒策略的进展。
key_findings_zh: H5N1病毒在宾夕法尼亚州家禽中至少68次独立引入,并发现哺乳动物适应性突变PB2 D701N [10.64898/2026.07.17.739193]。
牛源H5N1病毒可通过乳腺感染哺乳母猪,且感染呈亚临床状态,存在传播风险 [10.64898/2026.07.18.739312]。
H5N5病毒在斯瓦尔巴群岛北极熊和大西洋海象中检出,携带哺乳动物适应标记PB2-E627V [10.64898/2026.07.20.739480]。
中国监测发现新型H3N8和H3N3禽流感病毒,具有哺乳动物适应相关氨基酸替换 [10.1016/j.tvjl.2026.106789]。
多价VSV载体疫苗同时靶向H5N1血凝素和M2蛋白,在小鼠模型中提供完全保护 [10.1128/jvi.00097-26]。
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 禽流感病毒在哺乳动物中的适应性增强和跨物种传播事件增加,尤其是H5N1在奶牛和猪中的感染,以及H5N5在北极野生动物中的出现,提示病毒可能向人类传播的风险上升。
literature.caveats_zh: 多数研究基于动物模型或体外实验,人类传播风险仍需进一步评估;部分研究为预印本,尚未经同行评审。
literature.headline_en: Avian Influenza Virus Cross-Species Transmission and Adaptive Evolution Advances.
literature.lead_en: This week's studies reveal widespread H5N1 transmission and adaptive mutations in North American poultry and dairy cattle, emergence of H5N5 in Arctic wildlife, potential risk of novel H3N8/H3N3 viruses in China, and progress in novel vaccines and antiviral strategies.
key_findings_en: H5N1 was introduced into Pennsylvania poultry at least 68 times independently, with mammalian adaptive mutation PB2 D701N detected [10.64898/2026.07.17.739193]
Bovine-derived H5N1 efficiently infects lactating swine via mammary gland, with subclinical infection posing spillover risk [10.64898/2026.07.18.739312]
H5N5 detected in polar bear and walrus in Svalbard, carrying mammalian adaptation marker PB2-E627V [10.64898/2026.07.20.739480]
Novel H3N8 and H3N3 avian influenza viruses identified in Chinese poultry, with amino acid substitutions linked to mammalian adaptation [10.1016/j.tvjl.2026.106789]
Multivalent VSV-vectored vaccine targeting H5N1 HA and M2 provides full protection in mouse model [10.1128/jvi.00097-26]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: Increasing mammalian adaptation and cross-species transmission of avian influenza viruses, particularly H5N1 in cattle and swine and H5N5 in Arctic wildlife, suggest elevated risk of spillover to humans.
literature.caveats_en: Most studies are based on animal models or in vitro experiments; human transmission risk requires further assessment. Some studies are preprints not yet peer-reviewed.
literature.brief_en: This week's findings highlight the expanding host range and adaptive evolution of avian influenza viruses, with H5N1 and H5N5 showing increased mammalian adaptation, while novel vaccines and antivirals offer promising countermeasures.

news.headline_zh: 新西兰首现H5N1野鸟感染,紧急启动濒危物种疫苗接种。
news.lead_zh: 新西兰确认两只野鸟感染H5N1高致病性禽流感,政府随即对五种极度濒危鸟类启动紧急疫苗接种,并加强生物安全措施。
key_findings_zh: 新西兰在惠灵顿附近发现一只棕色贼鸥感染H5N1,为该国首例野鸟病例 [news-ac8d2e52e18c9767]。
环保部对包括南秧鸟和鸮鹦鹉在内的300只核心种鸟实施紧急疫苗接种 [news-5ad5e5232fa4c52c]。
最大蛋企Mainland Poultry将55万只散养鸡转入室内封闭管理,防范野鸟传播 [news-7111781c9cc816d2]。
MPI在检出H5N1后单日收到157起鸟类异常报告,显示公众监测意识提升 [news-3ac6666de240d03e]。
澳大利亚同期在三个州野鸟中检出14例H5N1,结束无疫状态,家禽业加强封锁 [news-fcb3f32777f3a281]。
news.trend_or_risk_zh: H5N1在澳新地区野鸟中扩散,对独特本土物种构成灭绝风险,并威胁散养家禽产业。
news.caveats_zh: 目前仅个别野鸟检出,尚无家禽感染或人际传播证据,但病毒在野鸟种群中的持续存在可能增加溢出风险。
news.headline_en: New Zealand detects first H5N1 in wild birds, launches emergency vaccination for endangered species.
news.lead_en: New Zealand confirmed H5N1 highly pathogenic avian influenza in two wild birds, prompting emergency vaccination of five critically endangered bird species and heightened biosecurity measures.
key_findings_en: A brown skua found near Wellington tested positive for H5N1, marking New Zealand's first wild bird case [news-ac8d2e52e18c9767].
The Department of Conservation began vaccinating 300 core breeding birds from species including takahē and kākāpō [news-5ad5e5232fa4c52c].
Mainland Poultry, the largest egg supplier, confined 550,000 free-range chickens indoors to prevent potential transmission from wild birds [news-7111781c9cc816d2].
MPI received 157 reports of dead or sick birds in a single day after the H5N1 detection, reflecting heightened public vigilance [news-3ac6666de240d03e].
Australia reported 14 H5N1 detections in wild birds across three states, ending its disease-free status and triggering industry lockdowns [news-fcb3f32777f3a281].
news.trend_or_risk_en: H5N1 is spreading in wild birds across Australia and New Zealand, posing extinction risks to unique native species and threatening free-range poultry operations.
news.caveats_en: Only sporadic wild bird detections so far; no poultry infections or human-to-human transmission confirmed, but persistent wild bird reservoirs may increase spillover risk.
news.brief_en: New Zealand confirmed its first H5N1 cases in wild birds and launched emergency vaccination for endangered species, while Australia ended its H5N1-free status with 14 wild bird detections. Both countries heightened biosecurity, with New Zealand confining 550,000 free-range chickens and Australia's poultry industry implementing lockdowns. Public reporting surged, but no poultry outbreaks or human cases have been confirmed.

papers.abstract: In 2024, the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) and National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) initiated an interagency collaboration to bolster preparedness in the event of a pandemic scenario due to high pathogenicity avian influenza A(H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b viruses that had been circulating in North America since 2021. Multiple spillover events into mammalian species, including an outbreak among dairy cattle and a surge in human cases, spurred the development of RNA reference materials to assist with new diagnostics development and validation. With input from CDC on sequences, NIST generated three synthetic RNA materials of A(H5N1) hemagglutinin, neuraminidase, and matrix proteins 1 and 2 gene segments. Here, we describe the development and characterization of these reference materials utilizing droplet digital reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction. Through this collaboration, we were able to rapidly provide quantified, homogeneous, stable, and epidemiologically relevant RNA reference materials to the public to aid new assay development and validation.

analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the collaboration as enabling rapid provision of reference materials, highlighting the novelty of their approach in addressing the urgent need for diagnostic tools during the A(H5N1) outbreak.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the urgent need for diagnostic preparedness against highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b viruses, which have been circulating in North America since 2021 and caused spillover events into mammals, including dairy cattle and humans. Through a collaboration between the CDC and NIST, the researchers developed and characterized three synthetic RNA reference materials for A(H5N1) hemagglutinin, neuraminidase, and matrix proteins using droplet digital reverse transcription PCR. These materials are quantified, homogeneous, stable, and epidemiologically relevant, designed to support new assay development and validation. The study provides a critical tool for enhancing diagnostic capabilities during potential outbreaks, though further clinical validation may be needed to fully assess their utility in real-world settings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 这项研究旨在加强对自 2021 年以来在北美流行的 高致病性禽流感 A(H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b 病毒引起的潜在大流行的准备,目的是开发 RNA 参考材料以协助新诊断的开发和验证。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项研究涉及美国疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 和美国国家标准与技术研究院 (NIST) 之间的合作,开发 A(H5N1) 病毒基因片段的 RNA 参考材料,该研究受到 跨物种溢出 事件的推动,在包括奶牛和人类病例在内的哺乳动物物种中发挥作用。
elements_zh.methods: NIST 利用液滴数字逆转录聚合酶链式反应进行表征,生成了 A(H5N1) 血凝素、神经氨酸酶和基质蛋白 1 和 2 基因片段的三种合成 RNA 材料。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究成功开发并表征了定量、均质、稳定且与流行病学相关的 RNA 标准物质,以帮助新的检测方法开发和验证。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将此次合作解释为能够快速提供参考材料,强调了他们的方法在解决 A(H5N1) 暴发 期间对诊断工具的迫切需求方面的新颖性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 通过提供用于测定验证的标准化参考材料,这些发现可以为 监测 和 禽流感 暴发 的诊断准备提供信息,特别是在有 A(H5N1) 病毒株流行的地区。

papers.title: Within- and between-host dynamics of highly pathogenic avian influenza in domestic birds from Pennsylvania farms and live bird markets
papers.abstract: Since late 2021, highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses (HPAI) of the H5 subtype clade 2.3.4.4b have spread across the Americas, devastating wildlife, agricultural animals, and resulting in dozens of human spillovers. National surveillance strategies generally provide only a single representative sequence per poultry outbreak, precluding fine-scale geographic transmission inference or studies of within-outbreak evolution. We produced high-quality deep sequence data from 46 infected Galliformes and Anseriformes sampled from commercial farm and live bird market (LBM) outbreaks in Pennsylvania from 2023-2025. We found that H5N1 viruses were introduced into Pennsylvania at least 68 independent times. We recover independent origins of live bird market outbreaks within the same county 3 weeks apart, and transmission between Pennsylvania LBM and New York commercial birds, suggesting high transmission risk within the Northeast live bird market distribution system. Analyses of within-farm variant populations show frequent variant sharing between samples from the same outbreak, suggesting that variants are propagated among epidemiologically linked infections. We identified 9 known adaptive mutations in these samples, including one instance of PB2 D701N in a LBM chicken sample, suggesting that while rare, concerning mammalian adaptive mutations can be present within these domestic outbreaks. Our data suggest that domestic bird outbreaks support high circulating diversity and wide transmission bottlenecks, increasing the risk of minority variants arising and propagating between infections. These data can help inform targeted biosecurity measures and better quantify the risk of viral adaptation during agricultural outbreaks.

papers.abstract_zh: 自 2021 年底以来,H5 亚型分支 2.3.4.4b 的 高致病性禽流感 病毒 (HPAI) 已在美洲蔓延,毁灭了野生动物和农业动物,并导致数十人死亡。国家 监测 策略通常只为每种家禽 暴发 提供一个代表性序列,排除了对 暴发 进化 内的精细地理 传播 推断或研究。我们从 2023 年至 2025 年从宾夕法尼亚州商业农场和活禽市场 (LBM) 暴发 采样的 46 只受感染的鸡形目和雁形目样本中生成了高质量的深度序列数据。我们发现 H5N1 病毒至少被引入宾夕法尼亚州 68 次。我们恢复了同一县内相隔 3 周的活禽市场 暴发 的独立来源,以及宾夕法尼亚州 LBM 和纽约商业鸟类之间的 传播,表明东北部活禽市场分销系统内的 传播 风险较高。对农场内变异群体的分析显示,来自同一 暴发 的样本之间经常存在变异共享,这表明变异在流行病学相关的感染中传播。我们在这些样本中鉴定出了 9 个已知的适应性 突变,其中包括 LBM 鸡样本中的一个 PB2 D701N 实例,这表明虽然罕见,但有关哺乳动物适应性的 突变 可能存在于这些家养 暴发 中。我们的数据表明,家禽 暴发 支持高循环多样性和广泛的 传播 瓶颈,增加了少数变异在感染之间产生和传播的风险。这些数据可以帮助为有针对性的生物安全措施提供信息,并更好地量化农业 暴发 期间病毒适应的风险。

papers.title: Standing HA phenotypic breadth shapes H5N1 cross-host potential
papers.abstract: Abstract Linking genetic variation to functional phenotype remains a major barrier to assessing the cross-host potential of emerging viruses. Here, we reconstruct the evolution of predicted hemagglutinin (HA) phenotypic traits across ~13,000 highly pathogenic avian influenza A H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b viruses circulating in North America. The wide geographic spread of avian influenza within North America triggered a wave of broad HA phenotypic diversity that was later refined by the selective sweeps in avian hosts. Following establishment in dairy cattle, however, viral populations exhibited renewed phenotypic diversification in HA, including increased permissiveness for α2,6-linked sialoside engagement despite high conservation of the receptor-binding domain. These patterns indicate that cattle-associated HA phenotypes can draw from standing predicted HA phenotypic breadth within circulating viral populations while continuing to diversify during cattle-associated circulation, rather than following only a simple stepwise adaptive path through canonical receptor-binding substitutions. By linking viral sequence variation to predicted protein properties across naturally evolving populations, this framework provides a scalable strategy for prioritizing H5N1 variants with cross-host-relevant features for targeted surveillance and experimental follow-up.

papers.title: The emergence of novel H3N8 and H3N3 avian influenza viruses in chickens during multi-province surveillance in China and their potential public health risk.
papers.abstract: The H3 subtype avian influenza virus (AIV) poses a substantial global public health threat due to its high host adaptability and ongoing evolution. The recent emergence of novel H3N8 and H3N3 AIVs associated with cross-species transmission underscores the urgent need for enhanced epidemiological surveillance. In this study, we conducted surveillance and characterization of H3 AIVs based on a total of 737 poultry samples collected across 21 Chinese provinces from November 2022 to December 2023. Of these, 69 (9.4%) tested positive for H3 AIV by RT-qPCR, and one H3N8 isolate and ten H3N3 isolates were obtained for whole-genome characterization. We performed whole-genome sequencing, phylogenetic analysis, reassortment inference, and evaluation of key amino acid substitutions, alongside antigenic characterization using hemagglutination inhibition (HI) assays and an in vivo mouse challenge experiment. The H3N8 isolate was identified as a triple-reassortant virus possessing the Eurasian avian H3 gene, the North American avian N8 gene, and H9N2-derived internal genes. The H3N3 isolates represented reassortant viruses that had acquired the HA gene from the novel H3N8 AIV lineage, the NA gene from H10N3 AIV, and internal genes from H9N2 AIV. All isolates exhibited HA cleavage sites characteristic of low pathogenic avian influenza viruses. Additionally, several amino acid substitutions previously associated with enhanced mammalian adaptation were identified, including L89V and I292V in PB2 and H436Y in PB1. In a BALB/c mouse challenge experiment, the representative H3N8 virus established infection without prior adaptation and replicated predominantly in the upper respiratory tract, with detectable viral RNA in respiratory tissues and limited extrapulmonary dissemination. Antigenic analysis revealed no cross-reactivity between the novel H3 AIVs and H5, H7, or H9 AIVs as measured by HI. Based on molecular and phylogenetic characterization, antigenic assessment, and preliminary mammalian infection data, our findings provide evidence suggesting a potential public health risk. We recommend intensified surveillance of H3 AIVs in poultry and accelerated vaccine development to curb viral spread and improve public health preparedness.

elements_en.main_results: Of the 737 poultry samples, 69 (9.4%) tested positive for H3 AIV by RT-qPCR, and one H3N8 isolate and ten H3N3 isolates were obtained for whole-genome characterization; all isolates exhibited HA cleavage sites characteristic of low pathogenic avian influenza viruses, and antigenic analysis revealed no cross-reactivity between the novel H3 AIVs and H5, H7, or H9 AIVs as measured by HI.

papers.title_zh: 中国多省监测期间鸡群中新型H3N8和H3N3 禽流感病毒的出现及其潜在的公共卫生风险。
papers.source_body_en: The H3 subtype avian influenza virus (AIV) poses a substantial global public health threat due to its high host adaptability and ongoing evolution. The recent emergence of novel H3N8 and H3N3 AIVs associated with cross-species transmission underscores the urgent need for enhanced epidemiological surveillance. In this study, we conducted surveillance and characterization of H3 AIVs based on a total of 737 poultry samples collected across 21 Chinese provinces from November 2022 to December 2023. Of these, 69 (9.4%) tested positive for H3 AIV by RT-qPCR, and one H3N8 isolate and ten H3N3 isolates were obtained for whole-genome characterization. We performed whole-genome sequencing, phylogenetic analysis, reassortment inference, and evaluation of key amino acid substitutions, alongside antigenic characterization using hemagglutination inhibition (HI) assays and an in vivo mouse challenge experiment. The H3N8 isolate was identified as a triple-reassortant virus possessing the Eurasian avian H3 gene, the North American avian N8 gene, and H9N2-derived internal genes. The H3N3 isolates represented reassortant viruses that had acquired the HA gene from the novel H3N8 AIV lineage, the NA gene from H10N3 AIV, and internal genes from H9N2 AIV. All isolates exhibited HA cleavage sites characteristic of low pathogenic avian influenza viruses. Additionally, several amino acid substitutions previously associated with enhanced mammalian adaptation were identified, including L89V and I292V in PB2 and H436Y in PB1. In a BALB/c mouse challenge experiment, the representative H3N8 virus established infection without prior adaptation and replicated predominantly in the upper respiratory tract, with detectable viral RNA in respiratory tissues and limited extrapulmonary dissemination. Antigenic analysis revealed no cross-reactivity between the novel H3 AIVs and H5, H7, or H9 AIVs as measured by HI. Based on molecular and phylogenetic characterization, antigenic assessment, and preliminary mammalian infection data, our findings provide evidence suggesting a potential public health risk. We recommend intensified surveillance of H3 AIVs in poultry and accelerated vaccine development to curb viral spread and improve public health preparedness.
papers.abstract_zh: H3 亚型 禽流感 病毒 (AIV) 由于其高 宿主 适应性和持续的 进化 对全球公共卫生构成重大威胁。最近出现的与跨物种 传播 相关的新型 H3N8 和 H3N3 AIV 强调了加强流行病学 传播 的迫切需要。在本研究中,我们基于 2022 年 11 月至 2023 年 12 月在中国 21 个省份收集的总共 737 份家禽样本,进行了 H3 AIV 的 监测 和表征。其中,69 份 (9.4%) 通过 RT-qPCR 检测出 H3 AIV 阳性,并获得了 1 株 H3N8 分离株和 10 株 H3N3 分离株用于全 基因组 鉴定。我们进行了全 基因组 测序、系统发育分析、重配推断和关键氨基酸取代的评估,同时使用血凝抑制 (HI) 测定和体内小鼠攻击实验进行抗原表征。H3N8分离株被鉴定为三重重组病毒,具有欧亚禽H3基因、北美禽N8基因和H9N2衍生的内部基因。H3N3 分离株代表重配病毒,这些病毒获得了来自新型 H3N8 AIV 谱系的 HA 基因、来自 H10N3 AIV 的 NA 基因以及来自 H9N2 AIV 的内部基因。所有分离株均表现出低致病性 禽流感 病毒的 HA 裂解位点特征。此外,还鉴定了先前与增强哺乳动物适应性相关的几个氨基酸取代,包括PB2中的L89V和I292V以及PB1中的H436Y。在 BALB/c 小鼠攻击实验中,代表性 H3N8 病毒在没有事先适应的情况下就建立了感染,并主要在上呼吸道复制,在呼吸道组织中可检测到病毒 RNA,肺外传播有限。抗原分析显示,通过 HI 测量,新型 H3 AIV 与 H5、H7 或 H9 AIV 之间没有交叉反应性。基于分子和系统发育特征、抗原评估和初步哺乳动物感染数据,我们的研究结果提供了表明潜在公共卫生风险的证据。我们建议在家禽中加强 H3 AIV 的 监测 并加速 疫苗 的开发,以遏制病毒传播并改善公共卫生准备。

papers.title: Immunization with deglycosylated H7N9 VLP enhances cross-strain protective antibody responses against avian influenza H7N9 variants in mice
papers.abstract: Introduction The rapidly evolving avian influenza H7N9 virus remains a threaten to public health globally. There is an urgent need to develop broad-spectrum vaccines capable of eliciting functional cross-strain protective immunity against emerging viral variants. Methods N-linked glycosylation can shield critical residues from immune recognition. Here, a prototype virus-like particle (VLP) was constructed based on the antigenic sequences derived from A/Taiwan/1/2013 H7N9 virus. Glycosidase enzymes were utilized to trim the glycan molecules for generating monoglycosylated VLP (VLPmg) and nonglycosylated VLP (VLPng) derivates. The structural integrity, antigenicity, and immunogenicity of these VLPs were systematically evaluated. Results Both VLPmg and VLPng maintained hemagglutination activity and antigenicity like the fully glycosylated prototype VLP (VLPfg). Immunization with deglycosylated VLPs induced robust virus-specific antibodies and a balanced Th1/Th2 immune profile in mice, whereas the titers were comparable to that of VLPfg. Among them, VLPng induced higher hemagglutination inhibition and neutralizing antibody titers against different H7N9 virus strains, indicating improved cross-strain reactive antibody responses. Conclusion This study demonstrated the enzymatic deglycosylation of influenza H7N9 VLP improves the induction of broadly protective antibody responses in mice. The nonglycosylated H7N9 VLP represents a potential vaccine candidate to against the threat of antigenically divergent H7N9 virus variants.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the potential of deglycosylated H7N9 virus-like particles (VLPs) to enhance cross-strain protective antibody responses against avian influenza H7N9 variants in mice. The research aimed to address the public health threat posed by the rapidly evolving H7N9 virus and the need for vaccines that can elicit broad-spectrum immunity. A prototype VLP was constructed from the A/Taiwan/1/2013 H7N9 virus, and glycosidase enzymes were used to generate monoglycosylated (VLPmg) and nonglycosylated (VLPng) derivates. The structural integrity, antigenicity, and immunogenicity of these VLPs were evaluated. Results showed that both VLPmg and VLPng maintained hemagglutination activity and antigenicity similar to the fully glycosylated prototype VLP (VLPfg). Immunization with deglycosylated VLPs induced robust virus-specific antibodies and a balanced Th1/Th2 immune profile in mice, with titers comparable to those of VLPfg. Notably, VLPng induced higher hemagglutination inhibition and neutralizing antibody titers against different H7N9 strains, indicating improved cross-strain reactivity. The study concluded that enzymatic deglycosylation of H7N9 VLPs enhances the induction of broadly protective antibody responses in mice, suggesting that nonglycosylated VLPs may serve as a vaccine candidate against antigenically divergent H7N9 variants. However, the study is limited to in vivo experiments in mice, and the results may not directly apply to humans. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the reliance on animal models and the absence of clinical data.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the threat posed by the rapidly evolving avian influenza H7N9 virus to global public health and to explore the development of vaccines capable of eliciting broad-spectrum protective immunity against emerging variants.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A prototype virus-like particle (VLP) was constructed based on the antigenic sequences from A/Taiwan/1/2013 H7N9 virus, and the structural integrity, antigenicity, and immunogenicity of these VLPs were systematically evaluated in mice.
analysis_en.methods: N-linked glycosylation was identified as a mechanism that shields critical residues from immune recognition, and glycosidase enzymes were used to trim glycan molecules to generate monoglycosylated VLP (VLPmg) and nonglycosylated VLP (VLPng) derivates.
analysis_en.main_results: Both VLPmg and VLPng maintained hemagglutination activity and antigenicity similar to the fully glycosylated prototype VLP (VLPfg). Immunization with deglycosylated VLPs induced robust virus-specific antibodies and a balanced Th1/Th2 immune profile in mice, with titers comparable to that of VLPfg.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study demonstrated that enzymatic deglycosylation of influenza H7N9 VLP improves the induction of broadly protective antibody responses in mice, highlighting a novel approach to vaccine development.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that nonglycosylated H7N9 VLPs could serve as a potential vaccine candidate to combat the threat of antigenically divergent H7N9 virus variants, offering implications for improved surveillance and vaccine design.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vivo experiments in mice, and the results may not directly translate to human immunity. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the lack of clinical data and the reliance on animal models.

papers.title_zh: 去糖基化 H7N9 VLP 免疫可增强小鼠针对 禽流感 H7N9 变种的跨品系保护性抗体反应
papers.source_body_en: Introduction The rapidly evolving avian influenza H7N9 virus remains a threaten to public health globally. There is an urgent need to develop broad-spectrum vaccines capable of eliciting functional cross-strain protective immunity against emerging viral variants. Methods N-linked glycosylation can shield critical residues from immune recognition. Here, a prototype virus-like particle (VLP) was constructed based on the antigenic sequences derived from A/Taiwan/1/2013 H7N9 virus. Glycosidase enzymes were utilized to trim the glycan molecules for generating monoglycosylated VLP (VLPmg) and nonglycosylated VLP (VLPng) derivates. The structural integrity, antigenicity, and immunogenicity of these VLPs were systematically evaluated. Results Both VLPmg and VLPng maintained hemagglutination activity and antigenicity like the fully glycosylated prototype VLP (VLPfg). Immunization with deglycosylated VLPs induced robust virus-specific antibodies and a balanced Th1/Th2 immune profile in mice, whereas the titers were comparable to that of VLPfg. Among them, VLPng induced higher hemagglutination inhibition and neutralizing antibody titers against different H7N9 virus strains, indicating improved cross-strain reactive antibody responses. Conclusion This study demonstrated the enzymatic deglycosylation of influenza H7N9 VLP improves the induction of broadly protective antibody responses in mice. The nonglycosylated H7N9 VLP represents a potential vaccine candidate to against the threat of antigenically divergent H7N9 virus variants.
papers.abstract_zh: 简介 快速进化的 禽流感 H7N9 病毒仍然对全球公共卫生构成威胁。迫切需要开发广谱 疫苗,能够引发针对新出现的病毒变种的功能性跨毒株保护性免疫。方法 N-连接糖基化可以保护关键残基免受免疫识别。在这里,基于 A/Taiwan/1/2013 H7N9 病毒的抗原序列构建了原型病毒样颗粒 (VLP)。利用糖苷酶修剪聚糖分子,以生成单糖基化 VLP (VLPmg) 和非糖基化 VLP (VLPng) 衍生物。对这些 VLP 的结构完整性、抗原性和免疫原性进行了系统评估。结果 VLPmg 和 VLPng 均保持与完全糖基化原型 VLP (VLPfg) 一样的血凝活性和抗原性。用去糖基化的 VLP 进行免疫可以在小鼠体内诱导出强大的病毒特异性抗体和平衡的 Th1/Th2 免疫特征,而滴度与 VLPfg 相当。其中,VLPng针对不同的H7N9病毒株诱导了更高的血凝抑制和中和抗体滴度,表明跨病毒株反应性抗体反应得到改善。结论 这项研究表明,流感 H7N9 VLP 的酶促去糖基化可改善小鼠体内广泛保护性抗体反应的诱导。非糖基化的 H7N9 VLP 代表了潜在的 疫苗 候选药物,可对抗抗原不同的 H7N9 病毒变种的威胁。

papers.title: Detection of H5N1 HPAIV Clade 2.3.4.4b Avian Influenza Virus in Backyard Chickens in Costa Rica
papers.abstract: Influenza A virus is a segmented, negative-sense RNA virus. Since the early 2020s, H5 clade 2.3.4.4b viruses have spread widely across Europe, Africa, and Asia, affecting wild birds and poultry. Costa Rica reported its first H5 clade 2.3.4.4b avian influenza virus (AIV) case on 19 January 2023. This study describes an outbreak in backyard chickens and ducks. Initial serum samples collected on 24 January showed three chickens negative for AIV, while one duck tested positive by ELISA and agar gel immunodiffusion (AGID). During a second visit on 27 January, three of four chicken sera collected tested positive by ELISA and AGID. Tissue samples were positive for influenza A by qRT-PCR. Next-generation sequencing recovered five of the eight viral genomic segments, and the hemagglutinin cleavage site sequence (REKRRKR↓G) confirmed a highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (HPAIV) H5 strain. The samples were submitted to the National Veterinary Services Laboratories for confirmation. Serological testing showed reactivity to North American low pathogenic H5 antigens, and qRT-PCR amplified influenza A and N1 genes. Virus isolation and next-generation sequencing (NGS) of all eight viral genome segments were successfully performed at the WHO Collaborating Centre at St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital (SJCRH).

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study was needed to detect and characterize H5N1 highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (HPAIV) clade 2.3.4.4b in backyard chickens in Costa Rica, following its first reported case in the country on 19 January 2023.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study describes an outbreak in backyard chickens and ducks, with samples collected on 24 and 27 January 2023 and submitted to the National Veterinary Services Laboratories for confirmation.
analysis.methods: Initial serum samples were tested by ELISA and agar gel immunodiffusion (AGID), tissue samples by qRT-PCR, and viral genomic segments by next-generation sequencing; virus isolation and full-genome sequencing were performed at the WHO Collaborating Centre at St. Jude Children's Research Hospital.
analysis.main_results: Three chickens tested negative for AIV on 24 January, while one duck tested positive; on 27 January, three of four chicken sera tested positive by ELISA and AGID; tissue samples were positive for influenza A by qRT-PCR, and sequencing confirmed a highly pathogenic H5 strain with the hemagglutinin cleavage site sequence REKRRKR↓G.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as evidence of H5N1 HPAIV clade 2.3.4.4b circulation in backyard poultry in Costa Rica, representing the first detection of this strain in the country and highlighting its spread to new regions.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform surveillance efforts for avian influenza in Central America, emphasizing the need for monitoring backyard poultry and early detection to prevent potential zoonotic transmission and outbreaks.

analysis.summary_en: This study reports the first detection of H5N1 highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (HPAIV) clade 2.3.4.4b in backyard chickens in Costa Rica, following its initial case reported on 19 January 2023. papers.title_zh: 哥斯达黎加后院鸡中 H5N1 HPAIV 分支 2.3.4.4b 禽流感 病毒的检测
papers.source_body_en: Influenza A virus is a segmented, negative-sense RNA virus. Since the early 2020s, H5 clade 2.3.4.4b viruses have spread widely across Europe, Africa, and Asia, affecting wild birds and poultry. Costa Rica reported its first H5 clade 2.3.4.4b avian influenza virus (AIV) case on 19 January 2023. This study describes an outbreak in backyard chickens and ducks. Initial serum samples collected on 24 January showed three chickens negative for AIV, while one duck tested positive by ELISA and agar gel immunodiffusion (AGID). During a second visit on 27 January, three of four chicken sera collected tested positive by ELISA and AGID. Tissue samples were positive for influenza A by qRT-PCR. Next-generation sequencing recovered five of the eight viral genomic segments, and the hemagglutinin cleavage site sequence (REKRRKR↓G) confirmed a highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (HPAIV) H5 strain. The samples were submitted to the National Veterinary Services Laboratories for confirmation. Serological testing showed reactivity to North American low pathogenic H5 antigens, and qRT-PCR amplified influenza A and N1 genes. Virus isolation and next-generation sequencing (NGS) of all eight viral genome segments were successfully performed at the WHO Collaborating Centre at St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital (SJCRH).
papers.abstract_zh: 甲型流感病毒是一种分段的负义RNA病毒。自 2020 年代初以来,H5 clade 2.3.4.4b 病毒已在欧洲、非洲和亚洲广泛传播,影响 野生鸟类 和家禽。哥斯达黎加于 2023 年 1 月 19 日报告了首例 H5 分支 2.3.4.4b 禽流感 病毒 (AIV) 病例。这项研究描述了后院鸡和鸭中的 暴发。1 月 24 日收集的初始血清样本显示,三只鸡的 AIV 呈阴性,而一只鸭通过 ELISA 和琼脂凝胶免疫扩散 (AGID) 检测呈阳性。在 1 月 27 日的第二次访问中,收集的四份鸡血清中的三份经 ELISA 和 AGID 检测呈阳性。qRT-PCR 检测组织样本甲型流感呈阳性。新一代测序恢复了八个病毒基因组片段中的五个,血凝素裂解位点序列 (REKRRKR↓G) 证实了 高致病性禽流感 病毒 (HPAIV) H5 株。样本已提交给国家兽医服务实验室进行确认。血清学检测显示对北美低致病性 H5 抗原有反应性,qRT-PCR 扩增了甲型和 N1 型流感基因。所有八个病毒 基因组 片段的病毒分离和下一代测序 (NGS) 均在圣裘德儿童研究医院 (SJCRH) 的世卫组织合作中心成功进行。

papers.title: Genetic Determinants Analysis of PB1 and PB2 Genes in H5N1 Avian Influenza Strains from Romania
papers.abstract: Avian influenza is a highly contagious viral disease affecting domestic and wild birds, caused by influenza A viruses of the family Orthomyxoviridae. Continuous genetic surveillance is essential for monitoring viral evolution and identifying molecular determinants associated with pathogenicity and host adaptation. In this study, the PB1 and PB2 polymerase genes of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 viruses detected in Romania between 2017 and 2024 were genetically characterized. A total of 18 organ samples collected from domestic and wild birds in several Romanian counties were analyzed by real-time RT-PCR, followed by conventional RT-PCR, Sanger sequencing, mutational analysis, and phylogenetic reconstruction. High-quality sequence data were obtained for six PB1 and eight PB2 gene fragments. Sequence analysis revealed a high degree of conservation within the PB1 gene, particularly across regions involved in viral replication, indicating strong evolutionary constraints. In contrast, the PB2 gene exhibited several amino acid substitutions, including changes at positions 464 and 678 in selected isolates. Notably, all analyzed strains lacked the mammalian adaptation marker E627K. Phylogenetic analysis clustered the Romanian isolates within Eurasian H5N1 lineages and demonstrated close genetic relationships with contemporary strains circulating in Eastern Europe and Russia. These findings highlight the genetic stability of PB1, the ongoing diversification of PB2, and the importance of continuous molecular surveillance for the early detection of viral variants with potential implications for host adaptation and zoonotic risk.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 禽流感 是一种影响国内和 野生鸟类 的高度传染性病毒性疾病,由正粘病毒科 A 型流感病毒引起。连续遗传 监测 对于监测病毒 进化 和识别与致病性和 宿主 适应相关的分子决定因素至关重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在这项研究中,对 2017 年至 2024 年在罗马尼亚检测到的 高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) H5N1 病毒的 PB1 和 PB2 聚合酶基因进行了基因表征。对从国内和罗马尼亚几个县的 野生鸟类 采集的总共 18 个器官样本进行了分析。
elements_zh.methods: 获得了 6 个 PB1 和 8 个 PB2 基因片段的高质量序列数据。通过实时 RT-PCR 分析样品,然后进行常规 RT-PCR、桑格测序、突变分析和系统发育重建。
elements_zh.main_results: 序列分析揭示了 PB1 基因内的高度保守性,特别是在涉及病毒复制的区域之间,这表明存在强大的进化限制。相比之下,PB2 基因表现出多个氨基酸取代,包括选定分离株中 464 和 678 位的变化。值得注意的是,所有分析的菌株都缺乏哺乳动物适应标记 E627K。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调了 PB1 的遗传稳定性、PB2 的持续多样化,以及连续分子 监测 对于早期检测病毒变异的重要性,这对 宿主 适应和人畜共患病风险具有潜在影响。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果通过强调需要监测 PB2 突变 的 宿主 适应标记和人畜共患潜力,为 监测 策略提供信息。与东欧和俄罗斯菌株的遗传关系凸显了跨境 传播 风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于样本量有限(18 个样本)并且重点关注两个聚合酶基因,该研究的证据强度中等。功能测定的缺乏限制了对观察到的 突变 生物学意义的解释。

papers.title: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza H5N5 in a Polar Bear and Atlantic Walrus, Svalbard, 2026, with Widespread Seroconversion in Polar Bears
papers.abstract: Abstract Highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (HPAIV) subtype H5N5 was detected in a one-year-old polar bear ( Ursus maritimus ) and an adjacent adult Atlantic walrus ( Odobenus rosmarus rosmarus ), both found deceased in Raudfjorden, Svalbard. This represents the first confirmed case of HPAI in a European polar bear and the second in an Atlantic walrus. Viral genomes were nearly identical and harbored PB2-E627V, a marker associated with mammalian adaptation. Several polar bears, including the deceased individual, had previously been observed feeding on the walrus carcass. Antibodies against H5 were detected in 75% of polar bears in 2023 (n=36) and 97% in 2024-2025 (n=65), suggesting extensive circulation of HPAIV in the population following the first detections in birds in Svalbard in 2022, whereas no antibodies were detected in samples from 2014-2022 (n=243).

This represents the first confirmed case of HPAI in a European polar bear and the second in an Atlantic walrus. Viral genomes were nearly identical and harbored PB2-E627V, a marker associated with mammalian adaptation. Several polar bears, including the deceased individual, had previously been observed feeding on the walrus carcass. Antibodies against H5 were detected in 75% of polar bears in 2023 (n=36) and 97% in 2024-2025 (n=65), suggesting extensive circulation of HPAIV in the population following the first detections in birds in Svalbard in 2022, whereas no antibodies were detected in samples from 2014-2022 (n=243).

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the emergence and spread of highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N5 in Arctic wildlife, specifically polar bears and Atlantic walruses, in Svalbard, following initial detections in birds in 2022.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study examined deceased polar bears and Atlantic walruses in Raudfjorden, Svalbard, and conducted serological testing on polar bear populations from 2014 to 2025.
analysis.methods: Viral genomes were sequenced to identify mutations, and serological testing was performed to detect H5 antibodies in polar bear samples using unspecified methods.
analysis.main_results: HPAIV H5N5 was detected in a one-year-old polar bear and an adult Atlantic walrus; viral genomes were nearly identical and contained PB2-E627V, a mammalian adaptation marker; 75% of polar bears tested in 2023 and 97% in 2024-2025 had H5 antibodies, compared to zero in 2014-2022.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as evidence of extensive HPAIV circulation in polar bears following spillover from birds, with the PB2-E627V mutation suggesting mammalian adaptation; this represents the first confirmed HPAI case in a European polar bear and second in an Atlantic walrus.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the risk of HPAIV transmission to marine mammals and Arctic wildlife, underscoring the need for enhanced surveillance in polar regions to monitor viral evolution and potential zoonotic threats.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate due to the small sample size of deceased animals and reliance on serological data without viral isolation; limitations include the inability to confirm transmission routes and potential sampling bias in polar bear populations.

analysis.summary_en: This study reports the first confirmed case of highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N5 in a European polar bear and an Atlantic walrus in Svalbard, 2026. Viral genomes from both animals were nearly identical and contained PB2-E627V, a marker associated with mammalian adaptation. Serological testing revealed a dramatic increase in H5 antibodies among polar bears, rising from 0% in 2014-2022 to 75% in 2023 and 97% in 2024-2025, indicating widespread viral circulation following initial bird detections in 2022. The findings suggest spillover from birds to marine mammals and highlight the risk of HPAIV establishment in Arctic wildlife, with potential implications for viral evolution and zoonotic transmission.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查 高致病性禽流感 H5N5 在斯瓦尔巴群岛的北极野生动物(特别是北极熊和大西洋海象)中的出现和传播,继 2022 年在鸟类中首次检测到后。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究检查了斯瓦尔巴群岛劳德峡湾死去的北极熊和大西洋海象,并对 2014 年至 2025 年的北极熊种群进行了血清学检测。
elements_zh.methods: 对病毒 基因组 进行测序以鉴定 基因组,并使用未指定的方法进行血清学测试以检测北极熊样本中的 H5 抗体。
elements_zh.main_results: 在一岁北极熊和成年大西洋海象身上检测到 HPAIV H5N5;病毒 基因组 几乎相同,并含有 PB2-E627V,一种哺乳动物适应标记;2023 年接受测试的北极熊中有 75% 拥有 H5 抗体,2024-2025 年则有 97% 拥有 H5 抗体,而 2014-2022 年则为零。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为继鸟类 跨物种溢出 之后北极熊体内广泛 HPAIV 循环的证据,其中 PB2-E627V 突变 表明哺乳动物的适应;这是首例欧洲北极熊确诊的高致病性禽流感病例,也是第二例大西洋海象确诊的高致病性禽流感病例。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了 HPAIV 传播 对海洋哺乳动物和北极野生动物的风险,强调极地地区需要加强 监测 来监测病毒 进化 和潜在的人畜共患威胁。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于死亡动物的样本量较小且依赖于未经病毒分离的血清学数据,证据强度中等;局限性包括无法确认 传播 路线以及北极熊种群中潜在的抽样偏差。

papers.title: Bovine-derived H5N1 influenza virus efficiently infects lactating swine via the mammary gland
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Since 2024, highly pathogenic influenza A(H5N1) viruses have spread extensively among U.S. dairy cattle, where they replicate efficiently in the mammary gland and are shed at high titers in milk. To directly assess susceptibility of commercial swine populations to bovine-derived H5N1 virus, lactating sows with prior influenza virus vaccination histories representative of U.S. commercial swine production systems were inoculated via the intramammary route and co-housed with their 1-week-old piglets to evaluate disease outcomes, viral replication, and potential for vertical transmission. Intramammary inoculation of lactating sows resulted in sustained viral RNA shedding in milk, while piglets exhibited sporadic oral viral RNA positivity that mirrored viral kinetics in milk. Lesions in mammary tissue and viral antigen staining, as well as development of neutralizing antibody responses and changes in milk color and consistency, further confirmed infection in the sows. Despite these molecular findings, none of the animals developed overt clinical disease, and respiratory involvement was not noted during the study period. Collectively, we demonstrate that intramammary exposure results in productive influenza A(H5N1) virus infection in lactating sows despite their vaccination histories, indicating the potential threat of viral spillover into commercial swine populations. The clinically inapparent nature of infection presents a risk of subclinical spread and underscores the importance of expanding viral surveillance to swine.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 进行了一项研究,其中代表美国商业养猪生产系统的既往有流感病毒 疫苗接种 历史的哺乳母猪通过乳房内途径接种,并与 1 周大的仔猪共同饲养。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,尽管哺乳母猪有 疫苗接种 病史,但乳房内暴露会导致甲型 H5N1 流感病毒感染,这表明病毒 跨物种溢出 对商业猪群存在潜在威胁,而且临床上不明显的感染性质存在亚临床传播的风险。

papers.title: Identification of two novel B-cell epitopes targeting the hemagglutinin protein of H9N2 avian influenza virus
papers.abstract: Abstract H9N2 avian influenza virus (AIV) remains a global threat to poultry health and has zoonotic potential. Antigenic drift in the hemagglutinin (HA) protein complicates vaccine efficacy and diagnostic accuracy, highlighting the need for precise epitope characterization. In this study, the HA protein of H9N2 AIV was expressed in a eukaryotic system, and two monoclonal antibodies (mAbs), 9C12 and 9F4, were generated. Both mAbs specifically bound HA, as shown by ELISA, Western blot, and immunofluorescence, but lacked hemagglutination inhibition activity. Epitope mapping revealed two minimal linear epitopes: 123 FSSSRSYQ 130 within the vestigial esterase domain and 201 NLYTRTDTT 209 within the receptor-binding domain. Alanine scanning revealed key residues required for antibody binding, whereas structural modeling confirmed that both epitopes are surface exposed. Sequence analysis demonstrated strong conservation across H9N2 strains, with the 9F4 epitope showing near-complete invariance, whereas both epitopes exhibited low conservation among other influenza A virus subtypes. These findings define two novel, nonneutralizing epitopes on H9N2 HA that expand the antigenic map and represent promising targets for subtype-specific diagnostic assays.

papers.title: Inactivation of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza Viruses Using Deep Ultraviolet Radiation of at Different Wavelengths 波長の異なる深紫外線による高病原性鳥インフルエンザウイルスの不活化
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses (HPAIVs) of the H5N1 subtype have been reported to infect not only birds, but also humans, cattle, and other mammals, posing a serious public health concern and highlighting the need for effective control measures. Ultraviolet (UV) irradiation is widely known as an effective modality for virus inactivation, and recent advances in LED technology have enabled the generation of UV light of various wavelengths, each with distinct characteristics. In this study, we evaluated the efficacy of four different UV wavelengths (222 nm, 230 nm, 254 nm, and 265 nm) in inactivating HPAIVs. HPAIV at a concentration of 2.0 × 106 plaque-forming units (PFU) /mL was irradiated with UV light at doses ranging from 0 to 7.3 mJ/cm2. The UV doses required to achieve a 99.9% reduction in the viral titer were 4.2 mJ, 4.9 mJ, 5.6 mJ, and 4.3 mJ for UV light wavelengths of 222 nm, 230 nm, 254 nm, and 265 nm, respectively. All four UV light wavelengths reduced viral titers by more than 99.9%, demonstrating their effectiveness in inactivating HPAIVs. This study demonstrated that UV light at all the four tested wavelengths effectively inactivated HPAIVs to a comparable extent, suggesting the usefulness of UV light for inactivating HPAIVs in a wide range of environments.

papers.title: Digital Health for Pandemic Preparedness: A Critical Review of Innovations, Equity Gaps, and Governance in Infectious Disease Surveillance
papers.abstract: Context: Recent infectious disease emergencies, including SARS-CoV-2, mpox (2022 - 2024), highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) in US dairy cattle (2024 - 2025), and the Marburg virus in Rwanda (2024), have strained traditional surveillance systems. Digital health has been proposed as a paradigm shift; however, most reviews have focused on diagnostic accuracy while neglecting equity and governance. Evidence Acquisition: We conducted a structured thematic narrative review of peer-reviewed and grey literature published from January 2010 to March 2025, reported in accordance with PRISMA 2020 and PRISMA-ScR. PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science were searched from February 5 to 18, 2025. Search keywords combined three concept blocks: (1) Digital-health technologies (artificial intelligence, machine learning, mHealth, eHealth, telemedicine, electronic health records, wearables, wastewater surveillance, genomic surveillance, natural-language processing); (2) infectious diseases (outbreak, pandemic, epidemic, COVID-19, Ebola, Zika, mpox, influenza, antimicrobial resistance, Marburg); and (3) public-health functions (surveillance, detection, forecasting, contact tracing, governance, equity). Full Boolean syntax is provided. Records were deduplicated in EndNote X20 and screened by 2 blinded reviewers in Rayyan (Cohen κ = 0.81). Empirical studies were appraised using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool 2018, and reviews were appraised using Joanna Briggs Institute checklists. The synthesis followed Braun and Clarke's reflexive thematic analysis and was interpreted through sociotechnical systems and data justice lenses. Results: Of 1498 records, 142 studies met the inclusion criteria; 48% (69/142) were rated as high quality. The evidence base was heavily skewed regionally (high-income countries [HICs], 41%; sub-Saharan Africa or South Asia, 19%). No technology was universally superior. Artificial intelligence (AI) studies were concentrated in HICs (18/32, 56%), whereas short-message-service (SMS) mHealth studies were concentrated in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs; 15/25, 60%). Recurring barriers included algorithmic bias, fragmented interoperability, donor-dependent sustainability, and slow benefit-sharing of pathogen data with LMICs. Conclusions: Across 142 included studies the synthesis supports a measured conclusion: Digital health is necessary but not sufficient for pandemic preparedness. The patterns most consistently observed in the evidence — regional skew, recurring governance failures, donor-dependent sustainability, and design choices that determine equity outcomes — together indicate that equity, sustainability, and accountability are constituents of effectiveness rather than obstacles to it. The binding constraint is increasingly political and institutional will rather than analytic uncertainty.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines digital health innovations for pandemic preparedness, focusing on infectious disease surveillance, with a central question on how these technologies address equity gaps and governance challenges in the context of recent pandemics including avian influenza A(H5N1).
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: A structured thematic narrative review of peer-reviewed and grey literature (January 2010–March 2025) following PRISMA 2020 and PRISMA-ScR, searching PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science (February 5–18, 2025). Included 142 studies (48% high quality), appraised using Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool 2018 and Joanna Briggs Institute checklists, with synthesis via Braun and Clarke's reflexive thematic analysis.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Digital health is necessary but not sufficient for pandemic preparedness. Regional skew (41% HICs, 19% sub-Saharan Africa/South Asia), governance failures, donor-dependent sustainability, and inequitable design choices are consistent patterns. Equity, sustainability, and accountability are integral to effectiveness, with political will as the binding constraint.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: No technology is universally superior; AI studies are concentrated in HICs (56%), while SMS mHealth dominates LMICs (60%). Recurring barriers include algorithmic bias, fragmented interoperability, slow benefit-sharing of pathogen data with LMICs, and regional underrepresentation.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Prioritize addressing regional inequities, improving interoperability, ensuring sustainable funding beyond donor dependence, and enhancing data-sharing mechanisms with LMICs. Strengthen governance frameworks to embed equity and accountability in digital health design for pandemic preparedness.

analysis.summary_en: This critical review evaluates digital health innovations for pandemic preparedness, emphasizing equity and governance gaps. Analyzing 142 studies (2010–2025), it finds digital health tools are necessary but insufficient without addressing regional skew (HICs vs. LMICs), algorithmic bias, and sustainability challenges. The consensus underscores that equity and accountability are core to effectiveness, constrained by political will rather than technical uncertainty. Recommendations include bridging regional divides, improving data-sharing with LMICs, and designing interoperable, donor-independent systems. The review highlights avian influenza A(H5N1) as a case study in recent pandemic responses.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述审查了用于大流行防范的数字健康创新,重点关注传染病 监测,核心问题是这些技术如何在包括 禽流感 A(H5N1) 在内的近期大流行背景下解决公平差距和治理挑战。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 继 PRISMA 2020 和 PRISMA-ScR 之后,对同行评审和灰色文献(2010 年 1 月至 2025 年 3 月)进行结构化主题叙述性回顾,检索 PubMed、Scopus 和 Web of Science(2025 年 2 月 5 日至 18 日)。包括 142 项研究(48% 高质量),使用 2018 年混合方法评估工具和乔安娜·布里格斯研究所清单进行评估,并通过 Braun 和 Clarke 的反思性主题分析进行综合。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 数字健康对于大流行病防范来说是必要的,但还不够。区域偏差(41%的高收入国家,19%的撒哈拉以南非洲/南亚)、治理失败、依赖捐助者的可持续性以及不公平的设计选择是一贯的模式。公平、可持续性和问责制是有效性不可或缺的组成部分,政治意愿是具有约束力的约束。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 没有一种技术是普遍优越的;人工智能研究集中在高收入国家 (56%),而 SMS 移动医疗在中低收入国家 (60%) 中占主导地位。反复出现的障碍包括算法偏差、互操作性分散、与中低收入国家的病原体数据利益共享缓慢以及区域代表性不足。

analysis_en.scope_and_question: The review examines digital health innovations for pandemic preparedness, focusing on infectious disease surveillance, with a central question on how these technologies address equity gaps and governance challenges in the context of recent pandemics including avian influenza A(H5N1).
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: A structured thematic narrative review of peer-reviewed and grey literature (January 2010–March 2025) following PRISMA 2020 and PRISMA-ScR, searching PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science (February 5–18, 2025). papers.title_zh: 应对流行病准备的数字健康:对传染病创新、公平差距和治理的批判性回顾 监测
papers.source_body_en: Context: Recent infectious disease emergencies, including SARS-CoV-2, mpox (2022 - 2024), highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) in US dairy cattle (2024 - 2025), and the Marburg virus in Rwanda (2024), have strained traditional surveillance systems. Digital health has been proposed as a paradigm shift; however, most reviews have focused on diagnostic accuracy while neglecting equity and governance. Evidence Acquisition: We conducted a structured thematic narrative review of peer-reviewed and grey literature published from January 2010 to March 2025, reported in accordance with PRISMA 2020 and PRISMA-ScR. PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science were searched from February 5 to 18, 2025. Search keywords combined three concept blocks: (1) Digital-health technologies (artificial intelligence, machine learning, mHealth, eHealth, telemedicine, electronic health records, wearables, wastewater surveillance, genomic surveillance, natural-language processing); (2) infectious diseases (outbreak, pandemic, epidemic, COVID-19, Ebola, Zika, mpox, influenza, antimicrobial resistance, Marburg); and (3) public-health functions (surveillance, detection, forecasting, contact tracing, governance, equity). Full Boolean syntax is provided. Records were deduplicated in EndNote X20 and screened by 2 blinded reviewers in Rayyan (Cohen κ = 0.81). Empirical studies were appraised using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool 2018, and reviews were appraised using Joanna Briggs Institute checklists. The synthesis followed Braun and Clarke's reflexive thematic analysis and was interpreted through sociotechnical systems and data justice lenses. Results: Of 1498 records, 142 studies met the inclusion criteria; 48% (69/142) were rated as high quality. The evidence base was heavily skewed regionally (high-income countries [HICs], 41%; sub-Saharan Africa or South Asia, 19%). No technology was universally superior. Artificial intelligence (AI) studies were concentrated in HICs (18/32, 56%), whereas short-message-service (SMS) mHealth studies were concentrated in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs; 15/25, 60%). Recurring barriers included algorithmic bias, fragmented interoperability, donor-dependent sustainability, and slow benefit-sharing of pathogen data with LMICs. Conclusions: Across 142 included studies the synthesis supports a measured conclusion: Digital health is necessary but not sufficient for pandemic preparedness. The patterns most consistently observed in the evidence — regional skew, recurring governance failures, donor-dependent sustainability, and design choices that determine equity outcomes — together indicate that equity, sustainability, and accountability are constituents of effectiveness rather than obstacles to it. The binding constraint is increasingly political and institutional will rather than analytic uncertainty.

papers.title: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomic profiling reveals distinct immune landscapes in murine lungs infected with H1N1 versus H5N1 influenza viruses
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Influenza A viruses of divergent pathogenicity elicit distinct host immune responses, yet the underlying cellular and spatial dynamics remain poorly defined. Here, we integrate single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) and spatial transcriptomics to systematically compare the immune landscapes in murine lungs following infection with seasonal H1N1 or a highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 virus belonging to clade 2.3.2.1. Analysis of 84,162 immune cells identifies 12 distinct cell types, suggesting that H1N1 infection is associated with robust interferon and inflammatory responses, characterized by alveolar macrophage depletion and extensive infiltration of monocytes and neutrophils. In contrast, H5N1 clade 2.3.2.1 infection is characterized by attenuated interferon signaling, delayed monocyte activation, dysregulated neutrophil maturation, and impaired intercellular communication—features that may be distinct from previously characterized H5N1 strains. Spatial mapping indicates distinct distribution and interaction patterns of immune cells between the two infections. Functional validation through myeloid cell depletion supports the critical role of the monocyte-macrophage axis in disease progression. These findings provide a high-resolution atlas of pulmonary immune responses to influenza viruses of differing pathogenicity and highlight cell-type-specific mechanisms of immune modulation. IMPORTANCE Seasonal H1N1 influenza virus causes annual epidemics, while highly pathogenic avian H5N1 virus has a high mortality rate and pandemic potential. Understanding why H5N1 causes more severe disease is critical for developing better treatments. In this study, we used advanced single-cell and spatial technologies to create a detailed map of the immune response in the lungs of mice infected with either H1N1 or a clade 2.3.2.1 H5N1 virus. We discovered that H1N1 triggers a strong, well-organized immune response that controls the virus. In contrast, H5N1 infection leads to a disorganized and weakened response where key immune cells fail to activate and communicate properly. These findings suggest that the H5N1 virus may evade and suppress the host’s immune system. Our study provides a high-resolution immune atlas and identifies potential targets for new therapies against severe influenza.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在这里,我们整合单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq) 和空间转录组学,系统地比较感染季节性 H1N1 或 高致病性禽流感 H5N1 病毒后小鼠肺部的免疫状况。该研究的重点是感染 H1N1 病毒或 clade 2.3.2.1 H5N1 病毒的小鼠。
elements_zh.methods: 在这项研究中,我们使用先进的单细胞和空间技术创建了感染 H1N1 或 clade 2.3.2.1 H5N1 病毒的小鼠肺部 免疫应答 的详细图谱。对 84,162 个免疫细胞的分析确定了 12 种不同的细胞类型。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 我们的研究提供了高分辨率的免疫图谱,并确定了针对严重流感的新疗法的潜在靶标。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告局限性。

papers.title_zh: 单细胞和空间转录组分析揭示了感染 H1N1 与 H5N1 流感病毒的小鼠肺部的不同免疫景观
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Influenza A viruses of divergent pathogenicity elicit distinct host immune responses, yet the underlying cellular and spatial dynamics remain poorly defined. Here, we integrate single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) and spatial transcriptomics to systematically compare the immune landscapes in murine lungs following infection with seasonal H1N1 or a highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 virus belonging to clade 2.3.2.1. Analysis of 84,162 immune cells identifies 12 distinct cell types, suggesting that H1N1 infection is associated with robust interferon and inflammatory responses, characterized by alveolar macrophage depletion and extensive infiltration of monocytes and neutrophils. In contrast, H5N1 clade 2.3.2.1 infection is characterized by attenuated interferon signaling, delayed monocyte activation, dysregulated neutrophil maturation, and impaired intercellular communication—features that may be distinct from previously characterized H5N1 strains. Spatial mapping indicates distinct distribution and interaction patterns of immune cells between the two infections. Functional validation through myeloid cell depletion supports the critical role of the monocyte-macrophage axis in disease progression. These findings provide a high-resolution atlas of pulmonary immune responses to influenza viruses of differing pathogenicity and highlight cell-type-specific mechanisms of immune modulation. IMPORTANCE Seasonal H1N1 influenza virus causes annual epidemics, while highly pathogenic avian H5N1 virus has a high mortality rate and pandemic potential. Understanding why H5N1 causes more severe disease is critical for developing better treatments. In this study, we used advanced single-cell and spatial technologies to create a detailed map of the immune response in the lungs of mice infected with either H1N1 or a clade 2.3.2.1 H5N1 virus. We discovered that H1N1 triggers a strong, well-organized immune response that controls the virus. In contrast, H5N1 infection leads to a disorganized and weakened response where key immune cells fail to activate and communicate properly. These findings suggest that the H5N1 virus may evade and suppress the host’s immune system. Our study provides a high-resolution immune atlas and identifies potential targets for new therapies against severe influenza.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 不同致病性的甲型流感病毒会引发不同的 宿主 免疫应答,但潜在的细胞和空间动力学仍不清楚。在这里,我们整合单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq) 和空间转录组学,系统地比较感染季节性 H1N1 病毒或属于进化枝 2.3.2.1 的 高致病性禽流感 H5N1 病毒后小鼠肺部的免疫状况。对 84,162 个免疫细胞的分析确定了 12 种不同的细胞类型,表明 H1N1 感染与强烈的干扰素和炎症反应相关,其特征是肺泡巨噬细胞耗竭以及单核细胞和中性粒细胞广泛浸润。相比之下,H5N1 进化枝 2.3.2.1 感染的特征是干扰素信号减弱、单核细胞激活延迟、中性粒细胞成熟失调和细胞间通讯受损,这些特征可能与之前表征的 H5N1 毒株不同。空间映射表明两种感染之间免疫细胞的不同分布和相互作用模式。通过骨髓细胞耗竭进行的功能验证支持单核细胞-巨噬细胞轴在疾病进展中的关键作用。这些发现为不同致病性的流感病毒提供了肺部 免疫应答 的高分辨率图谱,并强调了免疫调节的细胞类型特异性机制。重要性 季节性 H1N1 流感病毒导致每年流行,而高致病性禽 H5N1 病毒具有高 死亡率 率和大流行潜力。了解 H5N1 为何会导致更严重的疾病对于开发更好的 治疗 至关重要。在这项研究中,我们使用先进的单细胞和空间技术创建了感染 H1N1 或 clade 2.3.2.1 H5N1 病毒的小鼠肺部 免疫应答 的详细图谱。我们发现 H1N1 会触发一个强大的、组织良好的 免疫应答 来控制病毒。相比之下,H5N1 感染会导致反应混乱和减弱,关键免疫细胞无法激活和正常通讯。这些发现表明 H5N1 病毒可能逃避并抑制 宿主 的免疫系统。我们的研究提供了高分辨率的免疫图谱,并确定了针对严重流感的新疗法的潜在靶标。

papers.title: Conflicts hinder research into animal movements.
papers.abstract: Satellite tracking has revolutionized our understanding of animal migration, yet its reliability increasingly depends on the geopolitical stability of the regions frequented by wildlife. Here, we show that military-induced interference with global navigation satellite systems (GNSS) during ongoing conflicts in Eastern Europe has severely compromised the accuracy of global positioning systems (GPS)-based tracking data for black-headed gulls (Chroicocephalus ridibundus). In 2024-2025, GPS trajectories revealed erratic, low-quality, and geographically implausible positions coinciding with known zones of electronic warfare. These inaccuracies hinder efforts to locate breeding colonies, identify key stopover habitats, and assess disease transmission risks posed by migratory birds, particularly for zoonoses such as highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1. Our findings illustrate how modern conflicts now extend their impact into ecological research infrastructures, calling for systematic correction methods and international coordination to safeguard the robustness of movement ecology studies and One Health models in a geopolitically unstable world.

papers.title: A VSV-vector vaccine simultaneously targeting H5N1 hemagglutinin and matrix protein 2 induces robust neutralizing and ADCC antibody responses and provides full protection against lethal H5N1 infection in a mouse model
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Avian influenza A viruses, especially highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) viruses, pose a significant public health threat, and a multivalent vaccine is the primary prophylactic measure to control these viruses. To establish such a vaccine, we generated two multivalent vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV)-based vaccine candidates that simultaneously target H5N1 hemagglutinin (H5 05 or H5 22 ) and the ectodomain of matrix protein 2 (M2e) and characterized their ability to induce protective immune responses. Our results revealed that vaccine immunization induced high humoral immune responses against both the HPAI hemagglutinin (HA) protein and the M2 protein in mice. Intriguingly, vaccine-immunized mouse sera exhibited highly efficient neutralizing activity against the corresponding H5 pseudovirus and mediated potent and broad antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC) activity against M2e derived from human and avian influenza H5, H1, H3, and H7 viruses. Furthermore, both intranasal (IN) and intramuscular immunization (IM) of V-EtM2e/H5 22 provided efficient protection against HPAI H5N1 virus challenge in mice, with a 100% survival rate and a nondetectable viral load in several tissues. Notably, noninvasive mucosal IN delivery achieved protection equal to that of IM delivery at a 100-fold lower immunizing dose. These findings provide strong evidence for the effectiveness of a multivalent VSV-based vaccine against human (avian) influenza A viruses. IMPORTANCE Avian influenza, especially highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) viruses, can cause a highly contagious airborne disease that poses a significant public health threat. The development of a multivalent vaccine is very important to control these viral infections. In this study, we have developed a multivalent vaccine that simultaneously targets two critical HPAI H5N1 surface viral proteins and fully protects against highly pathogenic H5N1 infection in a mouse model. This study provides convincing evidence for the effectiveness of a multivalent vaccine against highly pathogenic influenza A viruses.

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在小鼠模型中进行的,虽然结果令人鼓舞,但还需要进一步的研究来评估 疫苗 在其他动物模型和人类中的功效。由于 免疫应答 的稳健性和在实验环境中观察到的全面保护,证据强度很高。

papers.title: The impact of acids, pH, and incubation time on avian influenza virus persistence in raw milk
papers.abstract: In March 2024, highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (HPAIV) clade 2.3.4.4. b H5N1 was detected in dairy cattle. Since detection, the virus has spread across 17 states, infecting more than 1000 dairy herds, causing concern for the dairy industry regarding the effects on dairy cattle, the risk associated with milk quality and production, and ultimately its risk to humans. It has been shown that pasteurization is sufficient to inactivate HPAIV, if present in milk, making it safe for human consumption. However, unpasteurized raw milk that is routinely consumed and used to make cheese, yogurt, and kefir is a public health concern. We acidified raw milk, a process that is analogous to the preliminary phase of generating fermented milk products, with acetic, propionic, lactic, or citric acid to pH 5; or acidified it with acetic acid to pH 6, 5, or 4. Each sample was subsequently spiked with low pathogenic avian influenza virus (LPAIV) and incubated at room temperature for up to 24 h before being inoculated into 10-day old specific-pathogen-free embryonating chicken eggs. Embryos were assessed daily for viability and hemagglutination assays on the allantoic fluid was used to confirm the presence of viable LPAIV. The reduction of viable virus was significantly correlated with both time and pH but not specific type of acid tested. An acid treatment at pH 4 and 5 progressively reduced viable LPAIV levels over time, with the most pronounced inactivation observed at 24 h. Samples at pH 6 had little reduction in virus viability.

papers.title_original: The impact of acids, pH, and incubation time on avian influenza virus persistence in raw milk

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study was needed due to the spread of highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (HPAIV) clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 in dairy cattle across 17 states, raising concerns about milk quality, production, and human health risks from unpasteurized raw milk.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved acidifying raw milk with various acids to different pH levels, spiking it with low pathogenic avian influenza virus (LPAIV), and incubating it at room temperature for up to 24 hours before inoculating into 10-day-old specific-pathogen-free embryonating chicken eggs.
analysis.methods: Samples were acidified with acetic, propionic, lactic, or citric acid to pH 5 or with acetic acid to pH 6, 5, or 4, spiked with LPAIV, incubated, and then inoculated into embryonating chicken eggs, with viability assessed daily via hemagglutination assays.
analysis.main_results: The reduction of viable virus was significantly correlated with both time and pH but not the specific type of acid tested; samples at pH 6 showed little reduction in virus viability, while acid treatment at pH 4 and 5 progressively reduced viable LPAIV levels over time.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that acid treatment, particularly at lower pH levels, can effectively inactivate LPAIV in raw milk, providing a novel approach to reduce public health risks associated with unpasteurized dairy products.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform potential interventions for reducing avian influenza virus persistence in raw milk, thereby mitigating risks to human health from unpasteurized dairy products used in fermented foods.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate, as the study was conducted in a controlled laboratory setting using embryonating chicken eggs, which may not fully replicate real-world conditions in dairy processing or human consumption.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the impact of acids, pH, and incubation time on avian influenza virus persistence in raw milk, motivated by the recent outbreak of HPAIV H5N1 in dairy cattle. Researchers acidified raw milk with various acids to different pH levels, spiked it with LPAIV, and incubated it before assessing virus viability in embryonating chicken eggs. Results showed that lower pH levels (4 and 5) significantly reduced viable virus over time, with pH 6 showing minimal effect, while the type of acid did not influence inactivation. The findings suggest that acid treatment could be a practical method to reduce avian influenza virus risks in unpasteurized dairy products, though further studies in real-world settings are needed.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于 高致病性禽流感 病毒 (HPAIV) 分支 2.3.4.4b H5N1 在 17 个州的奶牛中传播,引发了人们对未经高温消毒的原料奶的牛奶质量、生产和人类健康风险的担忧,因此需要进行这项研究。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及用各种酸将生奶酸化至不同的 pH 值,添加低致病性 禽流感 病毒 (LPAIV),并在室温下孵育长达 24 小时,然后接种到 10 日龄的无特定病原体的胚胎鸡蛋中。
elements_zh.methods: 将样品用乙酸、丙酸、乳酸或柠檬酸酸化至 pH 5,或用乙酸酸化至 pH 6、5 或 4,加入 LPAIV,孵育,然后接种到含胚鸡蛋中,每天通过血凝测定评估活力。
elements_zh.main_results: 活病毒的减少与时间和 pH 值显着相关,但与测试的酸的具体类型无关;pH 6 的样品显示病毒活力几乎没有降低,而 pH 4 和 5 的酸 治疗 随着时间的推移逐渐降低活的 LPAIV 水平。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,酸 治疗,特别是在较低 pH 水平下,可以有效灭活原料奶中的 LPAIV,为降低与未经巴氏消毒的乳制品相关的公共卫生风险提供了一种新方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为减少原奶中 禽流感 病毒持久性的潜在干预措施提供了信息,从而减轻发酵食品中使用的未经高温消毒的乳制品对人类健康的风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究是在受控实验室环境中使用胚胎鸡蛋进行的,这可能无法完全复制乳制品加工或人类消费的现实条件。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于 高致病性禽流感 病毒 (HPAIV) 分支 2.3.4.4b H5N1 在 17 个州的奶牛中传播,引发了人们对未经高温消毒的原料奶的牛奶质量、生产和人类健康风险的担忧,因此需要进行这项研究。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及用各种酸将生奶酸化至不同的 pH 值,添加低致病性 禽流感 病毒 (LPAIV),并在室温下孵育长达 24 小时,然后接种到 10 日龄的无特定病原体的胚胎鸡蛋中。
analysis_zh.methods: 将样品用乙酸、丙酸、乳酸或柠檬酸酸化至 pH 5,或用乙酸酸化至 pH 6、5 或 4,加入 LPAIV,孵育,然后接种到含胚鸡蛋中,每天通过血凝测定评估活力。
analysis_zh.main_results: 活病毒的减少与时间和 pH 值显着相关,但与测试的酸的具体类型无关;pH 6 的样品显示病毒活力几乎没有降低,而 pH 4 和 5 的酸 治疗 随着时间的推移逐渐降低活的 LPAIV 水平。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,酸 治疗,特别是在较低 pH 水平下,可以有效灭活原料奶中的 LPAIV,为降低与未经巴氏消毒的乳制品相关的公共卫生风险提供了一种新方法。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为减少原奶中 禽流感 病毒持久性的潜在干预措施提供了信息,从而减轻发酵食品中使用的未经高温消毒的乳制品对人类健康的风险。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据强度中等,因为该研究是在受控实验室环境中使用胚胎鸡蛋进行的,这可能无法完全复制乳制品加工或人类消费的现实条件。

papers.title: Newton Divided Difference Optimization for Fingerprint-Based Neural Virtual Screening against Avian Influenza A/H9N2
papers.abstract: Avian influenza A/H9N2 poses persistent zoonotic and veterinary threats, yet efficient computational tools for antiviral compound prioritization remain underdeveloped, particularly with respect to optimizer behavior in high-dimensional neural screening. This study proposes Newton Divided Difference (NDD) optimization, a lightweight positive diagonal curvature-aware training strategy, as a novel optimizer for fingerprint-based neural virtual screening against avian influenza A/H9N2, with the objective of evaluating its performance across aligned molecular fingerprint representations and chemically structured validation protocols. An aligned benchmark of 1,459 molecules consisting of 615 candidate active compounds and 844 decoys was represented by EState (79 features), PubChem (881 features), and Klekota–Roth (4,860 features) fingerprints, sharing identical molecule identities, labels, and split assignments. A fixed multilayer perceptron (MLP) classifier was trained with NDD and seven baseline optimizers under stratified, scaffold-key, and similarity-cluster split protocols across five repeated seeds. NDD achieved the highest descriptive ROC-AUC (Receiver Operating Characteriztic – Area Under the Curve) and PR-AUC (Precision-Recall Area Under the Curve) on Klekota–Roth fingerprints under scaffold-key and similarity-cluster protocols, and remained competitive under the stratified split with ROC-AUC of 0.9872. Architecture-sensitivity tests confirmed stable NDD performance across multiple network configurations, with ROC-AUC values ranging from 0.9876 to 0.9890. Compared with Hessian-free optimization, NDD reduced per-run runtime from approximately 50–54 seconds to approximately 8 seconds on Klekota–Roth under the same CPU-only configuration while achieving comparable ranking performance. The novelty of this work lies in the first systematic assessment of NDD for H9N2 neural virtual screening, demonstrating that positive diagonal curvature-aware scaling provides a practical, stable, and computationally efficient optimization alternative in sparse high-dimensional ligand-based screening settings, although external validation and prospective experimental confirmation remain necessary before practical antiviral prioritization.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 禽流感 A/H9N2 造成持续的人畜共患病和兽医威胁,但用于 抗病毒药物 化合物优先级排序的有效计算工具仍然不发达,特别是在高维神经筛选中的​​优化器行为方面。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究提出牛顿差分(NDD)优化作为一种​​针对 禽流感 A/H9N2 的基于指纹的神经虚拟筛选的新型优化器,目的是评估其在对齐的分子指纹表示和化学结构验证协议中的性能。
elements_zh.methods: 由 615 种候选活性化合物和 844 种诱饵组成的 1,459 个分子的对齐基准由 EState(79 个特征)、PubChem(881 个特征)和 Klekota–Roth(4,860 个特征)指纹代表,共享相同的分子身份、标签和分割分配。固定多层感知器 (MLP) 分类器使用 NDD 和七个基线优化器在分层、支架键和相似性聚类分割协议下跨五个重复种子进行训练。
elements_zh.main_results: NDD 在支架关键和相似性聚类协议下在 Klekota–Roth 指纹上实现了最高的描述性 ROC-AUC 和 PR-AUC,并且在分层分割下保持竞争力,ROC-AUC 为 0.9872。架构敏感性测试证实了跨多种网络配置的稳定 NDD 性能,ROC-AUC 值范围为 0.9876 至 0.9890。与无 Hessian 优化相比,在相同的仅 CPU 配置下,NDD 将 Klekota-Roth 上的每次运行时间从大约 50-54 秒减少到大约 8 秒,同时实现了相当的排名性能。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这项工作的新颖性在于首次对 H9N2 神经虚拟筛选的 NDD 进行系统评估,证明正对角线曲率感知缩放在基于稀疏高维配体的筛选设置中提供了实用、稳定且计算高效的优化替代方案。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,NDD 优化可以显着加速针对 禽流感 A/H9N2 的 抗病毒药物 化合物的虚拟筛选,而不会影响性能,从而有可能更快地确定候选药物的优先级,以进行进一步的实验验证。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 在实施实际的 抗病毒药物 优先级排序之前,外部验证和前瞻性实验确认仍然是必要的。由于该研究的计算性质和缺乏实验验证,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Subtype-specific neutralizing antibodies promote antigenic shift during influenza virus co-infection.
papers.abstract: Reassortment between different influenza strains occurs when they co-infect the same host cell. The emergence of a reassortant virus depends on both its intrinsic fitness and extrinsic factors, including preexisting humoral immunity. The generation of pandemic strains, such as H2N2 and H3N2, and zoonotic influenza A viruses, like H5N6, H5N8, and H7N9, in birds is suggested to be the result of extensive selection by preexisting antibodies. To further explore the role of humoral immunity in reassortment, we generated two divergent fluorescent protein-expressing viruses and used strain-specific and cross-reactive monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) to assess the impact of cross-immunity on reassortment. Our results indicate that all mAbs altered the genotypic diversity and significantly reduced the release of progeny virions in co-infected cells both in vitro and in vivo . Moreover, antibody transfer studies in mice revealed protection from challenge with divergent pathogenicity profiles. Notably, selection driven by a strain-specific mAb depended on its neutralizing specificity, whereas the selection driven by broadly reactive mAbs was independent of neutralization specificity. Our findings demonstrate that preexisting neutralizing antibodies shape reassortment and that strain-specific neutralizing antibodies promote antigenic shift during co-infection, which is not the case for broadly cross-reactive antibodies that recognize influenza viruses from different subtypes.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查预先存在的体液免疫如何影响共同感染期间流感病毒的重排,特别是在抗原转变的情况下。背景强调,当不同流感毒株共同感染同一个 宿主 细胞时,它们之间就会发生重配,并且重配病毒的出现取决于内在适应性和外在因素,例如先前存在的免疫力。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及生成两种不同的表达荧光蛋白的病毒,并使用单克隆抗体来评估交叉免疫对重配的影响。该研究在体外和体内进行,小鼠用于抗体转移研究,以评估针对不同致病性特征的保护作用。
elements_zh.methods: 为了探索体液免疫在重配中的作用,研究人员创建了两种不同的荧光病毒,并应用了毒株特异性和交叉反应的单克隆抗体。他们在体外和体内评估了这些抗体对共感染细胞的基因型多样性和子代病毒粒子释放的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果表明,所有单克隆抗体都改变了基因型多样性,并显着减少了共感染细胞中子代病毒粒子的释放。此外,小鼠中的抗体转移研究表明,可以保护免受不同致病性特征的攻击。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,预先存在的中和抗体会影响重配,与识别不同亚型的广泛交叉反应抗体不同,菌株特异性抗体在共感染期间促进抗原转变。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,了解中和抗体在重配中的作用可以为 监测 和 禽流感 的预防策略提供信息,特别是在共感染和抗原转变相关的情况下。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外和体内模型,证据仅基于抽象数据。这些结果得到了对共感染细胞的直接观察的支持,为重配过程中抗体驱动选择的解释提供了适度的信心。

papers.abstract_zh: 当不同流感毒株共同感染相同的 宿主 细胞时,就会发生不同流感毒株之间的重配。重配病毒的出现取决于其内在适应性和外在因素,包括预先存在的体液免疫。鸟类中 H2N2 和 H3N2 等大流行毒株以及 H5N6、H5N8 和 H7N9 等人畜共患甲型流感病毒的产生被认为是先前存在的抗体广泛选择的结果。为了进一步探讨体液免疫在重配中的作用,我们生成了两种不同的表达荧光蛋白的病毒,并使用毒株特异性和交叉反应性单克隆抗体(mAb)来评估交叉免疫对重配的影响。我们的结果表明,所有单克隆抗体都改变了基因型多样性,并在体外和体内显着减少了共感染细胞中子代病毒粒子的释放。此外,小鼠体内的抗体转移研究揭示了针对不同致病性特征的攻击的保护作用。值得注意的是,菌株特异性 mAb 驱动的选择取决于其中和特异性,而广泛反应性 mAb 驱动的选择则独立于中和特异性。我们的研究结果表明,预先存在的中和抗体会形成重配,并且毒株特异性中和抗体会促进共感染期间的抗原转变,而识别不同亚型流感病毒的广泛交叉反应抗体则并非如此。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,了解中和抗体在重配中的作用可以为 监测 和 禽流感 的预防策略提供信息,特别是在共感染和抗原转变相关的情况下。

papers.title: A neutralizing nanobody targeting a conserved lateral patch on HA1 confers protection against multiple H7 avian influenza viruses
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Human infections with H7 avian influenza viruses (AIVs) have been documented globally, involving multiple subtypes and geographic regions. However, effective therapeutics targeting H7 influenza viruses remain limited. Here, a panel of nanobodies targeting the HA1 domain of hemagglutinin (HA) was identified by yeast two-hybrid (Y2H) screening, and six candidates were subsequently validated to exhibit hemagglutination inhibition (HI) activity. Of these, a subset also displayed virus microneutralization (MN) activity, while all showed binding activity in ELISA assays. Among them, Nb74 exhibited inhibitory activity against four Chinese recombinant vaccine-matched strains (Rv1–Rv4), which were generated based on the HA sequences of the corresponding inactivated vaccine strains H7-Re1 to H7-Re4. The HI-IC 50 values were 0.23, 0.57, 3.65, and 43.75 μg/mL, respectively, and the MN-IC 50 values for Rv1–Rv3 were 0.02, 0.06, and 1.09 μg/mL. It also retained activity against diverse clinical isolates although HI potency varied among strains. In mouse challenge experiments, intratracheal administration of Nb74 conferred robust protection, achieving 100% and 80% survival against Rv1 and Rv2, respectively, when administered prophylactically (2 mg/kg) or therapeutically (4 mg/kg). Treated mice showed accelerated body weight recovery, reduced lung viral load, and alleviated pulmonary pathology. Mechanistic analyses indicated that Nb74 neutralizes virus by blocking viral attachment to the host. Furthermore, combined hydrogen-deuterium exchange mass spectrometry (HDX-MS) with escape mutant analysis mapped its epitope to a conserved lateral patch on the HA1 subunit, consistent with a conformational epitope. Overall, these results demonstrate the therapeutic promise of intratracheally delivered Nb74 and provide insights for H7 AIVs vaccine design. IMPORTANCE H7 avian influenza viruses (AIVs), including both low- and highly pathogenic strains, pose a persistent threat to poultry production and public health, while continuous antigenic evolution of the HA1 subunit undermines vaccine effectiveness. Broadly neutralizing agents against H7 AIVs are urgently needed for pandemic preparedness, yet nanobody-based therapeutics remain largely unexplored. In this study, we identified Nb74, a nanobody that inhibits hemagglutination and neutralizes multiple H7 strains. Importantly, intratracheal delivery of Nb74 conferred protective efficacy, supporting respiratory administration of nanobody therapeutics. Mechanistic analyses show that Nb74 blocks viral attachment by recognizing a conserved conformational epitope within a lateral patch of the HA1 subunit. These findings reveal a conserved and functionally vulnerable region on H7 hemagglutinin (HA) and support the development of nanobody-based antivirals and improved vaccine strategies against emerging H7 AIV threats.

analysis.summary_en: This study identified Nb74, a nanobody targeting a conserved lateral patch on the HA1 subunit of H7 avian influenza viruses, which demonstrated broad inhibitory activity against multiple strains.
